Episode 181. Mary's Dream (2)
As they left Tikan Palace, the gaze of the people in the street naturally gathered on them.
Mary was conscious of the hostility emanating from the people's gaze on Defuse.
It was only natural.
Even though he came to his senses in the end, the fact that he slaughtered hundreds of thousands of innocent people didn't change.
It tormented Mary. Her brother's hands were already stained with blood that could never be washed away.
Could I forgive my brother?
In fact, that doubt was the real reason Mary couldn't sleep for the past few days.
Even if she heard some excuses from Defuse today, Mary didn't feel confident that she could understand his fall into corruption.
As if they had made a promise, they walked silently for quite a while.
Eventually, Defuse and Mary found themselves out of the city center and reaching the beach.
Their footprints extended over the beach dyed red by the sunset.
"It seems like we've been walking for three hours already."
Finally, Mary opened her mouth first.
"Has it been that long? I thought about thirty minutes had passed."
Defuse, answering while turning back.
He could see Mary and the distant Tikan Palace in his eyes.
"Why are you delaying this much? After all, you don't want to talk about it, do you?"
In Mary's eyes staring at Defuse, resentment was building up.
"That's not it."
"Then what's the reason for dragging out the answer under the pretext of a walk?"
"You know why."
Mary paused for a moment, then shook her head.

"No, I don't know, so just tell me. I already heard from our youngest sibling. That receiving the power of the monstrosity is only possible if one willingly accepts it. If that's true, then my brother, you didn't betray us by force......"
"It's true."
Tuk!
Mary fiercely grabbed Defuse's shoulder. Defuse didn't try to remove her grip.
"So, are you saying you succumbed to the monstrosity because you couldn't withstand the torture?"
"That's not entirely wrong."
"Lies. The brother I know isn't someone who could be broken by something like torture."
"No, I was truly in despair from the endless torture. Both physically and mentally."
"What kind of torture did you endure?"

"It's impossible to explain in words. At some point, every moment was like a flickering light bulb, my consciousness would disappear and then return repeatedly. Each time, a bit of my memory also faded. In the end, I even couldn't remember my own name. But now it's all come back."
"So, you accepted the power of the monstrosity because your mind was completely destroyed...... I suppose, there's nothing else. I asked a needless question."
"Mary."
"Yes."
"Is this really enough?"
"What do you mean?"

"I was driven mad by torture. Is this the excuse you so desperately questioned me for? If this alone is enough, if you are confident you won't be tormented by my fall into corruption again. Let's go back now."
Mary didn't respond for a while and stared at Defuse.
"......No, it's not enough."
As Mary's grip loosened, Defuse started to walk away again.
Mary followed him, watching his footprints being washed away by the waves each time they hit the shore.
"One day, when the torture was still ongoing, the monster who was once my mother told me a fact."
"What was it?"
"She said my despair was the greatest contribution to completing her divinity. The more I suffered and despaired, the stronger her power became."

"At first, I didn't believe her words. But as time passed, I became anxious. If what she said was true, the monstrosity would continue to grow stronger as long as I lived, and I couldn't even die as I wished."
The special despair of a special existence.
Like Joshua, Defuse's despair was also a significant contribution to the completion of the monstrosity.

"A bit more time passed, and I became certain. Every time the monstrosity visited me, I could clearly see her power becoming more immense. Naturally, each time, I had no choice but to fall deeper into despair. At this rate, even if father returned, I thought he wouldn't be able to kill the monster."
As Defuse calmly continued his explanation, Mary closed her eyes tightly.
"But one day, the monstrosity proposed something to me."
"......To accept her power?"
"Yes. Whether I should continue to be tortured and add to the despair, or accept its power and fight alongside the youngest one. Either choice was a cliff."
"If only...... if only you could've endured a little more. If you hadn't ended up accepting the power of the monstrosity, surely...... we would've come to save you."
"If so, by now the monstrosity would have become an entity that could never be opposed."
"Are you saying we succeeded in this operation because the monstrosity shared its power with you?"
"Yes."
"That's just a dirty rationalization!"
Defuse didn't turn back to look at the furious Mary.
"Ha! Okay, then why did the monstrosity bother to share its power with you? If what you said was true, the monstrosity would have eventually won the war just by watching you despair."

"The monstrosity is obsessed with the youngest one. As soon as I became a fragment, I was able to look into the monstrosity's innermost thoughts. It doesn't just want to win. It wants to win after driving the youngest one to rock bottom. It wants the youngest one to become the same entity as it."
"So, you accepted the power and did those things?"
"Lady Mary!"
Just as Defuse was about to answer, someone called out to Mary, running towards the beach.
"The king......?"
It was Kasimir.
"Lady Mary, the meeting is about to start. Let's go."
"Why did the king come to deliver the news personally? Why didn't you send someone?"
Kasimir didn't answer.
Mary alternated glances between him and Defuse, feeling her heart suddenly pounding. Defuse didn't stop walking.
"Wait, just tell him to wait a minute. I still have things to hear from my brother."
Mary ran after Defuse again. Although she had only exchanged a few words with Kasimir, Defuse was already far away.
"Brother! Are you running away? Go slower! Is the reason you accepted the monstrosity's proposal really all there is?"
"Mary."
"Why!"
"When you were in Ricault's inner castle, fell for the Prophet's trick and were on the verge of death... what were you thinking?"
"Why are you bringing that up all of a sudden."
- It's strange... For some reason, I don't think the youngest one would keep falling for this trick.
Words Mary had said to the Prophet in Ricault's inner castle.
At that time when it seemed impossible to beat the enemy and she felt no hope at all, Mary was suddenly engulfed by a strange feeling.
Some enormous entity... I felt the youngest one would soon resolve this situation. Somehow, I felt the youngest one would eventually lead this fight to victory.
"I felt the same way. When I received the monstrosity's fragment, I felt the youngest one would soon come and destroy it."
"Lady Mary! Lady Mary...! You're late, you need to attend the meeting."
This time it was Enya. When she turned to look at Enya for a moment, she could see the pitch-dark night sky and the distant lights of Tikan Palace.
Even if she ran all night, it seemed she wouldn't be able to return to the Tikan Palace. She was already that far away.
Defuse was again far off in the distance. Mary shook her head and chased after Defuse with all her might.
"Brother, stop...!"
She finally caught up to Defuse. But Defuse just kept moving forward.

"For me, no matter how I flailed, I couldn't choose a better option. I decided that if I accepted the fragment and the youngest one killed me in that state, the monstrosity's power would inevitably weaken..."
"I get it, I get it. The meeting is starting now. Let's go back for now and talk more next time, okay?"
"Lady Mary!"
"Lady, everyone is waiting!"
From behind, she heard the voices of the Tona brothers.
"Both of you, why, why are you only looking for me! Don't you see Brother Defuse here? He's right next to me!"
Mary yelled without looking back at them.
If she took her eyes off Defuse once more, she felt she would never be able to catch up again.
"Brother, let's go back now. I'm sorry. After surviving thanks to your sacrifice that day, I kept bothering you with needless words. So please, just stop for a moment... please."
Then Defuse stopped walking and turned to look back at Mary. Unconsciously, Mary smiled. Due to her tears, Defuse's face was blurry.
"Mary. Whatever the reason for my choice, I can never be forgiven. I've committed unforgivable deeds. I've killed too many people."

"But, but in the end you did come back, didn't you? You originally accepted the power to reduce the monstrosity's strength, and thanks to you it happened. And when Glieck was finished, the number of people who survived thanks to you is countless...!"
"Either way, I just lost to the monstrosity. I lost because I was weak, and irresponsibly left the aftermath to the youngest one, you, and others."
"People can lose too...!"
"As a Runcandle, there are fights that one absolutely shouldn't lose. So, Mary, don't lose like I did, keep fighting. With the youngest one. With the people."
"Why do you keep talking as if you're about to disappear. Don't do that."
Defuse gave a faint smile.
"I told you before, you know. Stop and go back with them."
Mary turned around, holding onto Defuse's hand.
Kashmir, Enya, the Tona brothers who had called her earlier, along with all the comrades of Tikan were looking at her.
They were signaling for her to come back soon.
"It's just a meeting, why are all of you like this."
"Mary."
"I'll say we're going soon, together with brother."
"Mary. You have to go alone."
The moment Defuse said that, Mary felt Defuse's hand slipping out of her grip.
No matter how hard she tried not to lose him, she couldn't hold on. It felt like a dream, she couldn't put any strength into it.
Then Defuse gently pushed Mary's shoulder.
"Though I only experienced it through your dreams, Tikan is really a nice place."
"Brother!"
"But we have to reclaim our home. Because the home of Runcandel is the Garden of Swords."
"Brother Defuse! Don't go!"
"It was nice to be able to walk together after a long time."
You must be brave, even without me, my little sister.
Brother...!
Mary collapsed.
The moment she tried to get up to chase after Defuse again, what came into her eyes was not his retreating figure.
It was her brothers and comrades, with worried faces, guarding her bedside.
"Lady Mary!"
"Lady Mary has woken up!"
"Hi, sister woke up!"
"Lady!"
Jin hugged Mary tightly.
For a while, Mary blankly stared at the ceiling, then she hugged Jin.
Yona and the Tona brothers also hugged the two of them together.
And Valeria, who was in front of them, opened the record window to show Mary.
<Defuse Runcandel shares the power of the monstrosity with Mary Runcandel and Jin Runcandel, betting on hope.>
<On May 22, 1803, Defuse Runcandel left the world along with a piece of the monstrosity's power. The monstrosity, becomes weaker.>
Mary couldn't take her eyes off that record for a long time.
